NieR: Automata and Replicant coming to PUBG New State


Square Enix’s NieR: Automata and the NieR Replicant remake will be featured in PUBG New State in an upcoming collaboration.   New collaboration coming soon to NEW STATE MOBILE! 🙌 #NEWSTATEMOBILE #NieR #NewStatexNieR @NieRGame pic.twitter.com/1Cp8O1mfhX



— NEW STATE MOBILE (@NEWSTATEMOBILE) February 24, 2022

While an action RPG series which features fantasy sword fighting may seem like a weird choice as a collaboration with a battle royale shooter, there has been weirder collabs in the world of mobile gaming in the past. It’s also worth noting that bullet hell elements are present in both NieR titles, so it may be interesting to see how traditional firearms fare against magic.

Besides the announcement of the collab, there is not a lot to go by regarding the collab. A release date has not been revealed, so it appears that players will have to wait for more updates.
The NieR series is no stranger to collabs, frequently appearing in other mobile gacha games, primarily Square Enix’s own mobile games such as NieR ReIncarnation, SINoALICE and Final Fantasy Brave Exvius. However, it’s surprising that a battle royale shooter like PUBG New State will feature the NieR series.
Recently, it was also announced that NieR: Automata will be getting its own anime. You can read more about it here.
To stay updated with the collab, follow PUBG New State on Twitter.

reference_summary: Square Enix's Nier: Pembuatan semula Automata dan Nier Replicant akan datang ke PUBG New State dalam kerjasama masa depan. The Battle Royale Shooter akan menampilkan siri RPG Action, yang terkenal dengan pertarungan pedang fantasi dan elemen neraka peluru. Tarikh pelepasan belum diumumkan. Nier sering bekerjasama dengan permainan mudah alih yang lain, tetapi ini menandakan kerjasama pertamanya dengan penembak Battle Royale. Tetap dikemas kini dengan kerjasama dengan mengikuti negeri baru PUBG di Twitter.
